summary: I keep hearing about this survey of teen iPhone use all over the tech press..and I don't believe it. I don't believe any any survey until I read the methodology but this is off. Not sure 84% of US teens own a smart phone. That seems high. Furthermore the students I work with are mainly Android. They may want an iPhone but the can't afford it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I keep hearing about this survey of teen iPhone use all over the tech press..and I don't believe it. I don't believe any any survey until I read the methodology but this is off.

Not sure 84% of US teens own a smart phone. That seems high. Furthermore the students I work with are mainly Android. They may want an iPhone but the can't afford it.
